name: JobGod
tagline: Runs your whole job hunt from intake to ready-to-send applications
description: Carries a job search end to end in one place. A setup wizard captures your background, a spreadsheet keeps every application and its stage visible, and scout digests land only after you approve them. Resume rewrites wait for your sign-off, and finished applications are packaged so you can submit them yourself.
author: DevinSoto
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
